confusion_matrix.definition: Injected positive NLOS labels evaluated only after independent fitting. Gaussian/continuous-loss decisions use weight < weight_decision_threshold; hard rejection decisions use frozen zero weight. Dropped pings excluded; undefined denominator=null. Other contamination factors are not NLOS labels.

empty_denominators.definition: Injected positive NLOS labels evaluated only after independent fitting. evidence.interpretation: Frozen weighted local Jacobian information checked independently; positive-part robust curvature excludes negative scalar curvature and geometry second derivatives. No uniqueness inference.

evidence.m5_bounds_contract: Existing strict-interior exponential LM transform retained; every saved final parameter checked against its declared bounds in artifact review.

evidence.paired_geometry_change_definition: Each delta is robust minus Gaussian raw canonical-frame RMSE on identical observations/physical starts. Negative is geometric improvement. Includes finite nonconverged outcomes; unavailable failed pairs counted separately. Numerical changes within1e-6m not classified as gains/losses.

scope.wrapper: perf_counter around solve_experiment, includes objective/diagnostic construction and offline validation, excludes generation and disk saving
scope.solver: sum saved per-start runtime_s; includes hard-rejection pilot and second stage, excludes wrapper truth evaluation
scope.limits: Local small fixtures, one start, three repeated paired seeded data realizations; no general solver ranking or throughput claim

evidence.interpretation: Paired local small-fixture timings include diagnostics/validation overhead and system contention. They do not establish general speed rankings.

independence: Scalar robust costs/gradients/weights/curvatures and geometric range/prior equations assembled independently. Existing M5 coordinate unpack/bases define declared model; no native M6 residual/Jacobian is used as expected value.
